summary: E-commerce project with Razorpay integration. Customer ordering flow needs a delivery details form (name, address, phone number) before payment, and admin panel must display this customer information for order fulfillment.
architectural_notes: Order flow: product selection → customer details form (name, address, phone) → Razorpay payment
Customer delivery details must be stored and visible in admin panel per order
known_issues: Currently skipping customer details form — goes directly from product selection to Razorpay payment page

existing_features.title: Insert a Customer Delivery Details form step between product/cart selection and the Razorpay payment initiation. The form must collect: Full Name, Delivery Address (multi-line), and Phone Number. Validate that all three fields are non-empty before allowing payment to proceed. This applies to both the 'Buy Now' flow on ProductDetail page and the checkout flow on the Cart page.

Display the customer delivery information (Full Name, Delivery Address, Phone Number) in the Admin Orders panel. Show these fields in the order list cards and in the OrderDetailModal so admins can fulfil deliveries.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a customer details form (name, address, phone number) that appears after product selection and before the Razorpay payment page
Display customer delivery information (name, address, phone number) in the admin panel for each order
Update the Order and related backend data types to include customer delivery fields: fullName (Text), address (Text), and phoneNumber (Text). Ensure these fields are stored with every order record.
